title: Efficacy of atosiban for repeated embryo implantation failure: A systematic review and meta-analysis.

answer.design_quote: The results of subgroup analysis based on study types (prospective randomized controlled clinical trial, retrospective cohort study and prospective cohort study) showed that in all types of studies, CPR of atosiban group was significantly higher than controlled group.
answer.k_quote: Two prospective randomized controlled trials (RCTs), one prospective cohort study and four retrospective cohort studies were included.
